sourcePrinciples: Heavy work below light work using complete repetitions/sets; each lift has its own arithmetic.
Heavy/light is a long-term method, not a requirement to max out or use a universal percentage.
appDecisions: Existing wave key, light-stage progression, heavy rep selection and exposure thresholds stay intact.
Correct qualifying light work establishes the cap for the derived heavy target.
Configured loads remain fixed despite misreported actual loads. Full matched heavy work clears heavy difficulty; reduced/failed work never advances the track.
Heavy rebuild/redistribution is capped again after reductions to preserve the strict total-work relationship.
limits: No automatic load increase, full independent heavy-volume progression or universal source 50–80% prescription is added.
If no whole heavy set fits, it remains blocked for explicit pair/program review.
